note: Kelly-standard candidate cards (2b): photo, a short bio in the candidate's own site's words, and published contact â€” each read from the cited page on the date recorded, every photo URL HEAD-verified as an image. Photo rule (tightened 2026-08-14, 2b): a clean solo portrait or honest initials â€” NEVER a screengrab, banner, logo crop, or a photo where the candidate is not the unambiguous sole subject. A challenger has no official portrait, so the campaign site's own photo is the legitimate source when it passes that bar â€” recorded and labeled as such; when it does not, initials render and the miss is a recorded hunt. Every shipped photo is listed with its source URL in docs/photo-report.md for human verification. Bios are the site's words, attributed, never our characterization. A candidate without an entry still renders a card (name, party, links, reaction control); every bio/photo absence is a recorded hunt below, never a blank presented as a fact.
